10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve | H&S Bike-Discount GmbH
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across sources: €4.50, €5.99, €13.90, €16.99 (ebike24.com) and €49.99, €33.99, €16.95, €11.99, €5.95, €3.79, €9.99 (bike-discount.de). Median of all 11 retail prices = €11.99
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from 11 distinct retail prices found across both sources. Prices represent current and regular pricing for various Schwalbe Clik Valve products and retrofit kits. The median value of €11.99 represents the middle price point across all offerings.

27.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve - Tubeless-Ventil - 2er Set - 80 mm
27.evidenceText: Three distinct product pages identified: p1859950.html (80mm), p1859948.html (40mm), p1859949.html (60mm). Source 4 is an upgrade kit accessory, Source 5 is a category page.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product listing URLs with distinct product SKUs. Excluded Source 4 (Umrüstkit/upgrade kit accessory) and Source 5 (category/collection page). Sources 1-3 represent three separate product listings with different valve lengths (40mm, 60mm, 80mm).

36.evidenceText: The provided content discusses Clik Valve pump head adapters and accessories but does not contain information about product page layouts, 'frequently bought together' sections, or 'related products' displays.
36.extractionRationale: The evidence does not contain data about what fraction of Clik valve product pages display accessories in 'frequently bought together' or 'related products' sections. While pump heads and adapters are mentioned as products that exist, there is no information about product page cross-selling ratios or attachment rates.

37.sourceTitle: CoreCap Valve Cap Set - BBB Cycling
37.evidenceText: The provided source describes CoreCap valve cap features and compatibility but does not list or count distinct replacement/spare part SKUs for valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kits.
37.extractionRationale: The source page lacks any information about spare parts inventory, SKU counts, or replacement kit offerings. It only describes the main CoreCap product specifications.

45.evidenceText: DT Swiss sources mention "DT Swiss tubeless valve" as standard technology but make no mention of Clik valve adoption. Hunt sources discuss tubeless-ready wheelsets without reference to Clik. No evidence of Clik adoption by any of the six major brands (DT Swiss, Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) in 2026/2027 product lines.
45.extractionRationale: Based on review of all three sources, there is no evidence that any major wheelset brand has adopted Clik valve as standard in 2026 or 2027 product lines. DT Swiss promotes its own proprietary tubeless valve technology, and Hunt discusses tubeless compatibility without mentioning Clik. The absence of any Clik adoption evidence across the provided sources results in 0% conversion rate.

49.evidenceText: Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One R, Perfomance, RaceGuard, TLR, Addix, 45-622 Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve
49.extractionRationale: Across all 4 sources from 99spokes.com comparisons, only the Bergamont Grandurance 10 (2026) model explicitly lists Clik valve in its specifications. This model appears in all 4 comparison pages with Clik valve confirmed. Other models mentioned (BULLS MACHETE RX 1, Liv Devote Advanced 2, Giant Revolt Advanced 2, Trek Checkpoint SL 5, Canyon Grizl CF 7, Specialized Diverge 4, Cannondale Topstone Carbon 3) do not show Clik valve specifications in the provided evidence.

50.evidenceText: Found 2 distinct Clik Valve-specific pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - technical product page with installation instructions for DV and SV valves, and (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - FAQ page about bike tire valves featuring Clik Valve. Other URLs mention Clik Valve but are product pages for other items (Aerothan tube, Airmax, Press).
50.extractionRationale: Counted unique schwalbe.com URLs that are specifically Clik Valve technical documents, installation guides, or FAQ pages. Excluded press pages and product pages for other items that only mention Clik Valve incidentally. The two relevant pages are the dedicated Clik Valve product page and the Valve FAQ page.
